subject: Temporary SLA uplift & rate-cap exception request for LaunchCo launch
messages:
From: Elliot Ramos <elliot.ramos@launchco.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@launchco.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question — launch traffic spike and rate caps

Hi Monica,

We're ramping up to a soft launch the week of Aug 2 and expect a concentrated spike in token usage for ~48 hours as we seed new users (attached is a minute-level forecast). Our engineering lead flagged Redwood's per-key rate caps — we wanted to check whether a temporary, scoped uplift is possible (we'll only use it for two API keys and will annotate calls).

Key asks:
- Short window: Aug 2 00:00 UTC — Aug 4 00:00 UTC (48 hrs)
- Increase per-minute throughput by ~3x for the two keys
- Ensure fallbacks to lower-cap variants if capacity constrained

This launch is tied to our Series B PR and missing this window would materially affect adoption. Happy to sign an amendment or put a card on file for any overage.

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility.

Best,
Elliot Ramos
Head of Platform, LaunchCo
E: elliot.ramos@launchco.com
A: LaunchCo, 120 Mission St

Attachment: LaunchCo_traffic_forecast.csv (CSV, 42 KB)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question — launch traffic spike and rate caps

Monica / Aditya —

Thanks for flagging. Operational proposal for LaunchCo's 48-hour window:

Summary:
- Window: 2027-08-02T00:00Z — 2027-08-04T00:00Z (48 hours)
- Scope: two API keys (will only accept calls with header X-LaunchCo-Phase: seed)
- Uplift: increase per-minute token quota from 10k -> 30k (3x) for those keys
- Burst smoothing: allow a 10-minute rolling burst window at 4x baseline to absorb short spikes
- Fairness: maintain proportionate fairshare across customers by applying temporary weighted fairshare (LaunchCo weight = 1.5) so we don't starve smaller customers
- Latency SLO target: maintain p95 < 200ms where feasible — if p95 degrades > 250ms for >10 minutes, automatic rollback trigger
- Fallbacks: automatic fallback to smaller model variant and per-region routing to lower-util regions if capacity crosses 85%
- Telemetry: enable detailed request sampling and tag traces with launch_co=true; retention 14 days for the period

Operational steps:
1) Aditya to approve cost delta and confirm whether we bill or provide interim credit (I estimate ~$12k incremental for 48h at expected throughput).
2) I will deploy the scoped rate rule and runbook (temp_rate_runbook.pdf attached) to the control plane by 2027-08-01 18:00Z and schedule a dry-run on Aug 1 22:00Z UTC.
3) On-call SRE to monitor latency and capacity dashboards and be on standby for the window.
4) Post-window we will revert quotas and provide a short incident report within 48 hours.

Risks / mitigations:
- Risk: unexpected cross-region traffic concentrates in a single AZ — mitigation: immediate re-route to secondary region and apply throttles on noisy keys.
- Risk: cost materially exceeds forecast if traffic sustained beyond window — mitigation: automatic caps and finance notification.

If we get commercial sign-off from Laura today I can finalize the runbook and schedule the deploy.

-Karthik
Sr. Manager, Serving Infrastructure
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: temp_rate_runbook.pdf (PDF, 128 KB)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question — launch traffic spike and rate caps

Folks —

I'm OK to approve a timeboxed exception under the following commercial conditions:
- Redwood provides a one-time credit of up to $8,000 against forecasted incremental consumption. Any overage beyond that will be billed at standard overage rates unless pre-approved.
- LaunchCo must provide the two API key IDs and the request header annotation by EOD Friday (2027-07-30).
- We need a rollback window scheduled and a post-mortem within 48 hours of end of window.

Operationally, Kar's plan looks reasonable. Two asks for SRE/infra: confirm the automatic rollback trigger and ensure the runbook includes an explicit communication template for the customer if we need to throttle.

Monica — please confirm LaunchCo provides the key IDs and accept the $8k credit; once confirmed I'll send a short amendment to sign. Aditya — please confirm accounting has visibility and pre-approve invoicing path. Kar — proceed with runbook prep and schedule the dry-run as proposed.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
